detail.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory
detail.summary: Causal memory requires not only state persistence but the capacity to influence future dynamics through a reconstructible causal log. This revision distinguishes between passive persistence and functional memory, incorporating evidence on how objective records emerge from environmental redundancy.
detail.reason: Integrating multi-source evidence on objective records (peer-17863ca893e94ce45e0c0b05) and thermodynamic bounds (peer-427813deb09b39377e5049e9) improves the rigor of the notebook's foundational claims.

detail.title: Operational Criteria for Physical Causal Memory
detail.summary: Operational causal memory requires internal states to maintain persistent, predictive correlations with future environmental states. Effective memory emerges when environmental coupling allows for coarse-grained reconstruction of relevant historical dynamics, distinct from simple state persistence.
detail.reason: Incorporating structural correlations and filter-theoretic approaches to refine memory definitions.
